Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 go_block('pt_batch_hdr') ;
 execute_query ;
 go_block('units_information');
 if :s_unit_count = 0 then
 show_error('0085');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 execute_query;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 end if;
exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select contract_id
 into :contract_id
 from batch_inputs
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND then
 show_error('1130');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :s_unit_count
 from units
 where batch_id = :batch_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 selection VARCHAR2(1) ;
begin
 begin
 select checkin_user_id into :checkin_user_id
 from batch_inputs
 where batch_id = :ctrl_blk_1.batch_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ;check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select 'x' into selection
 from utrs
 where unit_id = :unit_id
 and result_status_1 is null
 and rownum = 1 ;
 :pending_flag := ' Y ' ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then :pending_flag := ' N ' ;
 when others then handle_error ;check_package_failure ; 
 end ;

-- Added by HCL-C to calculate check digit 
:units_information.chk_digit := 
 chk_digit_query(:units_information.unit_id,null,null);
:units_information.os_chk_digit := 
 chk_digit_query(:units_information.os_unit_id,null,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id);
 check_package_failure;
 end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_BATCH_ID_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select pbh.batch_id,pbh.test_id,batch_inputs.contract_id from pt_batch_hdr pbh,batch_inputs where pbh.chapter_id = :s_chapter_id and substr(pbh.batch_id,8,2)='PT' and pbh.batch_id=batch_inputs.batch_id and batch_inputs.insert_dats between trunc(sysdate)-21 and sysdate and batch_inputs.chapter_id=:s_chapter_id order by insert_dats desc

begin

 end if ;
end;
